title.en: An act to authorize the Mortgage of Private Real Property in favor of any individual, corporation, or association subject to certain conditions
title.orig: An act to authorize the Mortgage of Private Real Property in favor of any individual, corporation, or association subject to certain conditions

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1947/ra_133_1947.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, private real property may be mortgaged for a period not exceeding five years, renewable for another five, in favor of any individual, corporation, or association, but the mortgagee or his successor in interest, if disqualified to acquire or hold lands of the public domain in the Philippines, shall not bid or take part in any sale of such real property as a consequence of such mortgage.
All laws, orders, or regulations, or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Act, are repealed or modified accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1947
